description:
Self-contained, separately-deployable Redis session store for WSO2 Identity Server.
        Registers a SessionDataStore and a UserSessionDAO, which the framework selects through the
        SessionStoreImplType configuration. Extends the abstract SessionDataStore that ships in
        carbon-identity-framework, where the pluggable supertype and the JDBC default live.
        Supports the standalone, sentinel and cluster topologies, with a hybrid-hash value layout
        and native per-key TTL.
